title: Circuit acceptance and quadratic extensions
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, and let $w$ be an input assignment. The circuit accepts $w$ if and only if there is a vector over $\bbr_2$ with one coordinate for the constant and one for each input and gate that satisfies the circuit's homogeneous quadratic system and whose input coordinates encode $w$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit $C$ on $n$ input bits
